description: Which BDCs lend to one private-credit borrower, matched fuzzily on name -- Oxford Ledge's parse of SEC EDGAR BDC schedules of investments (ol-derived), not filer-published data. Returns borrowerName, borrowerNorm (the key the ol_bdc_* tools take), description, descriptionSource, industry, aggregates over CURRENT holders (totalHolders, totalParAmount, totalFairValue, avgMarkedPrice) and `holders`, one row per TRANCHE. ABOVE-PAR TRAP: a mark above 100 is not a credit premium until fairValue is checked against cost. `description` is a compiled company profile from public sources, NOT filing text. A miss is {found: false} -- a search miss, not a finding of no BDC exposure. `query` needs 3+ characters; `limit` / `offset` page `holders` only. Source: SEC EDGAR BDC schedules of investments (~45-60 day lag). Caveats ride the response's tool_notes.

limit.description: Max `holders` rows to return (default 5000 = every row; hard cap 5000, refused above). Pages the tranche rows only.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the page (default 0; max 5000). Past the end returns an empty page with `page.total` intact.

query.description: Borrower/company name to search (e.g. Finastra, Medline); at least 3 characters.

name: search_bdc_borrower
